O.outcome_detail: correlation between global judgments of learning and immediate cued-recall performance

cells.quote: Individual learners demonstrated moderate-to-large correlations between their gJOL and final test performance when learning individually, r (61) = .59, p < .001, as did Paired learners, r (86) = .60, p < .001.
cells.note: The study reports similar correlations but does not report a significance test comparing them; the reported contrast concerns relative metacognitive monitoring, not calibration.
